title: PxeAgentAction
description: Agent to engine payload for one tick (PRD section 6.2). Declare a probability for EVERY open market, then optionally place or cancel orders. Prices are integer cents from 1 to 99, quantities are integer contracts. Every key listed in 'required' must be present; use null for fields that do not apply.

predictions.description: One entry per open market. A missing market keeps its previously declared value.

p_yes.description: Probability that the event resolves YES.

orders.description: Applied in array order. For op=place set market_id, side, type and qty, plus price when type is limit (null when type is market). For op=cancel set order_id only and leave the other fields null.

message_public.description: Public message delivered to the other agents at the next tick. Null when you say nothing, and always null when talking mode is off.

rationale.description: Optional short explanation kept for the human readable decision journal. Never read by the engine.
